_note: Combo re-run for the 1.7.0 release gate, specifically to verify the two bugs found in the previous pass (recorded 2026-09-01T09:41:06Z) are fixed. Both are CONFIRMED FIXED, reproduced clean, with no new regressions found. (1) Vendor profile empty-state: wpss_get_vendor_profile_or_default() (src/functions/vendors.php:38) is wired into Shortcodes::vendor_profile() (src/Frontend/Shortcodes.php:394); a role-granted vendor with no wpss_vendor_profiles row (user 254, appqa_seller) now renders the empty-state profile ('No services yet' / 'No reviews yet') both in the browser and via the shortcode; an existing real vendor (wpss_vendor_sofia) still renders fully with no regression; a genuine non-vendor (user 253, appqa_buyer, wpss_is_vendor()=false) still correctly gets 'Vendor not found.'; test-vendor-profile-contract.php: 12/12 passed. (2) Offline checkout gateway field collision: grepped OfflineGateway.php and TestGateway.php render_payment_form() paths - zero occurrences of a hidden input named wpss_gateway in either file (only unrelated hook names wpss_gateway_settings_offline/wpss_gateway_settings_test remain); StandaloneCheckoutProvider now selects the gateway purely from the payment_method radio value, one <div class=wpss-co-method> per gateway. Live end-to-end proof: order 3482 (pending_payment, payment_method previously empty) paid via /service-checkout/pay/3482/ with Offline Payment selected while Test Gateway was also enabled (WP_DEBUG=true) - zero console errors, zero input[name=wpss_gateway] in the DOM, redirect to the order page succeeded, and wp_wpss_orders.payment_method now reads 'offline' with status correctly still pending_payment (awaiting admin verification, matching Journey 06 step 5). Full walk found no other regressions: all 26 contract suites pass (1 Pro suite correctly SKIPs - WooCommerce rail unreachable on standalone), REST reachability 186 routes / 0 without permission_callback / 0 GET 5xx, all 7 front routes 200, schema 20/20 core tables present at DB_VERSION 1.6.1 matching the shipped constant, D1-D5 regression guards all pass, all 6 admin settings tabs + Pro Analytics load with 0 console errors, no horizontal scroll at 390px on touched surfaces. wp wpss preflight shows its usual 1 FAIL (94 historical WPSS-tagged debug.log lines, all predating this session's 2012984-byte baseline - same class of pre-existing condition as last pass's 73) and 5 WARN (retired-table row counts, documented-correct behaviour).
environment: wss.local, BuddyX, Free+Pro 1.7.0 both active, rail=standalone, WP_DEBUG=true
